# MCP & Plugin Session Integration

Covers MCP server lifecycle, reconnection, tool search, dynamic updates, and plugin session features.

## MCP Transport Types

Claude Code supports three MCP transport protocols [7]:
- **stdio**: Local processes, communication via stdin/stdout
- **SSE**: Server-sent events
- **HTTP**: Streamable HTTP

## MCP Configuration Scopes

| Scope | Location | Shareable |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| User/Global | `~/.claude/settings.json` (mcpServers key) | No |
| Project (shared) | `.mcp.json` in project root | Yes (committed) |
| Project (personal) | `.claude/settings.local.json` | No |
| Dynamic | Via CLI `--mcp-config` | Session-only |
| Plugin | Plugin `.mcp.json` | With plugin |

Project-scoped servers require approval before first use. Reset with `claude mcp reset-project-choices` [7].

## MCP Server Lifecycle

MCP servers are launched as separate processes during session initialization [7]. The MCPConnectionManager coordinates multiple transports and maintains session state [discovery agent findings].

### Reconnection Behavior

HTTP and SSE servers support automatic reconnection with exponential backoff [discovery agent findings]:
- 5 attempts: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s
- Server shows "pending" during reconnection attempts
- Marked "failed" after exhausting retries

Stdio servers are explicitly excluded from automatic reconnection — once disconnected, they are marked "failed" [discovery agent findings]. This is a known limitation with multiple GitHub issues requesting improvement [discovery agent findings].

## Tool Search (Deferred Loading)

By default, only MCP tool names load at session start — full schemas are deferred and loaded on demand via tool search [6][24]:

| Metric | Value | Source |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Context saved by deferral | ~95% (e.g., 66,000 tokens to ~120) | [27][28] |
| Activation threshold | >10% of context consumed by MCP tools | [27][28] |
| Tools returned per search | 3-5 tool_reference blocks | [24] |
| Model requirement | Sonnet 4+/Opus 4+ | [24] |
| Accuracy: Opus 4 | 49% to 74% on MCP evaluations | [23] |
| Accuracy: Opus 4.5 | 79.5% to 88.1% | [23] |

Configuration via `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` environment variable [27]:
- `auto` (default): Activate when MCP tools exceed threshold
- `true`: Always load full schemas
- `false`: Always defer
- `auto:5`: Use 5% threshold instead of 10%

## Dynamic Tool Updates (list_changed)

Claude Code supports MCP `list_changed` notifications that allow servers to dynamically update available tools, prompts, and resources without requiring manual reconnection [7]. Multiple GitHub issues report implementation gaps where notifications are sent but Claude Code does not always re-fetch tool lists [discovery agent findings].

## Plugin Session Integration

Plugins can include several session-relevant components [15]:

| Component | Location | Purpose |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Skills | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Namespaced as `/plugin:skill` |
| Agents | `agents/` | Custom subagents |
| Hooks | `hooks/hooks.json` | Event handlers |
| MCP servers | `.mcp.json` | External tool connections |
| LSP servers | `.lsp.json` | Code intelligence |
| Monitors | `monitors/monitors.json` | Background watchers |
| Executables | `bin/` | Added to Bash PATH |
| Settings | `settings.json` | Default agent, status line |

### Background Monitors

Monitors run continuously during a session, watching logs/files/status and delivering stdout lines as notifications to Claude [15]:

```json
[{
  "name": "error-log",
  "command": "tail -F ./logs/error.log",
  "description": "Application error log"
}]
```

### Plugin Loading

- `--plugin-dir`: Load plugin for session only [15]
- Local `--plugin-dir` plugins override installed marketplace plugins with same name [15]
- `/reload-plugins`: Pick up changes without restarting [15]
- Live change detection for skill directories [13]

## MCP in Managed Settings

MCP server configurations cannot be distributed through server-managed settings [16]. However, `allowManagedMcpServersOnly` and `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` can control which servers are permitted [5].

## Known Issues

- MCP stdio servers do not auto-reconnect after disconnect [discovery agent findings]
- Clean SIGINT shutdowns may be reported as "failed" due to EOF/broken pipe handling [discovery agent findings]
- `defer_loading` configuration may not work consistently across all configuration files [discovery agent findings]
- 15-minute authentication cache (`~/.claude/mcp-needs-auth-cache.json`) can block reconnection attempts [discovery agent findings]
- list_changed notifications not reliably processed in all versions [discovery agent findings]

## Gaps and Limitations

- Reconnection behavior details (exponential backoff timing, attempt counts) come from community sources and GitHub issues rather than official documentation
- No official documentation on MCPConnectionManager internals
- Plugin monitor lifecycle management (start/stop conditions) not fully documented [15]
- Interaction between plugin settings.json and project/user settings precedence not explicitly documented
